decisions.reason: Its weaker website presence after launch and the delayed, region-limited commercialization suggest results likely fell below aspiration, making reallocation of resources more attractive by 2022.
It remained fully presented through 2019, and as a specialized dosimetry component it likely still fits the firm's core portfolio well enough to stay above a minimum aspiration level.

Although another small-volume chamber increases overlap risk, the product had sustained standalone promotion and is close enough to core capabilities that the firm would likely continue it unless performance clearly disappointed.
A standard clinical ionization chamber is closely tied to the firm's established business, so even moderate performance would likely justify retention given portfolio fit and low search pressure.

Its continued standalone presentation in 2019 indicates at least initial acceptance, and its role in relative dosimetry makes it a complementary product the firm is likely to carry with available organizational slack.
As a thimble ionization chamber in a coherent product family, it likely benefits from shared capabilities and customer relationships, reducing the chance of withdrawal absent clear underperformance.
